summary: Iteration 4 verifies SPM/Program separation. Backend: 14/14 pytests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py pass. Verified GET /api/programs?kind=spm returns 12 SPMs sorted (SPM-01..SPM-12), ?kind=program returns 4 programs (after KIA restoration - see RCA), no-kind returns 16. Back button returns to /laporan-spm. Submitted SPM report visible in Laporan SPM list and NOT in Laporan Program list. Dashboard Program for PJ KIA still shows only KIA (1 card). PJ KIA master/program (KIA) and master/spm (SPM-01) show add-indicator button.

minor.issue: Same seeding robustness issue as iter3: KIA program was missing from DB at start of iter4 (only 3 programs with kind='program' remained: GIZI/IMUN/TB). Had to be manually re-inserted + 4 orphan Sep 2026 KIA reports repointed. seed_all is guarded by meta.seeded flag so deleted entities are never restored. Recommendation: seed each program idempotently (upsert by code) rather than gating by meta flag.
